To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Salmonella in the feed ingredients is the primary source of Salmonella in poultry carcases.
Salmonella in raw ingredients is the major factor contributing to contamination of poultry carcases.
the raw feed ingredients of an integrated poultry operation can serve as vehicles for dissemination of Salmonella serovars to chicken carcases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the epidemiology of Salmonella infections in poultry.

the development of a system of Salmonella control in the feed industry, which will minimize the contamination of the feed ingredients and thus reduce the incidence of Salmonella in the finished carcases.
the development of an efficient, rapid method for the identification of salmonellae.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the raw feed ingredients were the major sources of Salmonella in the live birds and carcase.
Salmonella serotypes in the feed ingredients are the primary source of carcase contamination in poultry processing plants.
the Salmonella serotypes in the raw feed were the source of the serotypes in the finished product.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Salmonella serotypes in raw ingredients were the source of contamination in live birds and finished carcases.

a significant correlation exists between Salmonella serotype prevalence in raw feed ingredients and in finished poultry carcases, and that a significant Salmonella reduction could be achieved in carcases by minimizing Salmonella prevalence in the meal and grains constituents of poultry feeds.
the Salmonella contamination rate of raw feed ingredients is a good indicator of Salmonella in the live birds and carcase contamination rate in the processing plant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Salmonella contamination of raw feed ingredients is a significant source of Salmonella contamination in the finished chicken product.
the feed industry should be more aware of the Salmonella contamination problem in their products.
Salmonella in raw poultry feed ingredients may serve as an important source of carcase contamination in the processing plant.
